# Anchor (vendored)

[Anchor](https://acidgorgon.github.io/Anchor/) saves player data (session-locked, a drop-in upgrade of ProfileStore 1.0.3).
It replaces DataService in this template. Rojo maps `src/` to `ServerScriptService.Anchor`.

Copied from https://github.com/Acidgorgon/Anchor at commit 5c2d526 (`src/`, `LICENSE`, `NOTICE`; Apache-2.0).
To update, copy `src/` from a newer commit over this one. This copy goes away once Anchor has a Wally package.
